Title: Single Source of Truth
Rule: Every governed master value must originate from one registered library record.

Title: Immutable Identity
Rule: Approved records retain immutable IDs across revisions and deployments.

Title: Tenant Isolation
Rule: Tenant-owned records must never be visible across tenants without explicit sharing.

Title: Global Inheritance
Rule: Tenants may inherit global records and override only fields marked configurable.

Title: Approval Before Use
Rule: Draft or rejected records cannot be used in production calculations.

Title: Effective Dating
Rule: Only records valid for the transaction date may be selected.

Title: Version Pinning
Rule: Estimates and projects pin the exact library version used.

Title: No Silent Replacement
Rule: Superseding a record must not silently rewrite historical transactions.

Title: Source Provenance
Rule: Every cost, rate, formula and AI knowledge record requires a traceable source.

Title: Confidence Governance
Rule: AI-derived or inferred records require confidence scoring and review thresholds.

Title: Unit Compatibility
Rule: Relationships and formulas may combine only dimensionally compatible units.

Title: White Label Segregation
Rule: Brand-specific templates and content must remain scoped to the owning brand.

Title: Custom Field Safety
Rule: Tenant custom fields may extend but not redefine protected canonical fields.

Title: Deprecation Window
Rule: Deprecated items remain searchable for historical traceability but cannot be newly selected.

Title: Four-Eyes Approval
Rule: High-impact pricing, formula and compliance changes require separate author and approver.

Title: Bulk Import Staging
Rule: Bulk imports enter staging and require validation before publication.

Title: Duplicate Prevention
Rule: Potential duplicates must be flagged before approval.

Title: Regional Precedence
Rule: Project-specific pricing overrides regional, tenant and global defaults in controlled order.

Title: Audit Completeness
Rule: Every create, edit, approval, rejection and archive action must be auditable.

Title: Rollback Capability
Rule: Published versions must support rollback without deleting audit history.
